items.title: 국가폐암검진 AI 판독 보조 80개 기관으로 확대...유방암검진도 도입 검증
items.excerpt: 정부가 국가폐암검진에 쓰이는 AI 판독 보조프로그램 적용 기관을 내년부터 현재 70곳에서 80개 검진기관으로 늘리고, 유방암검진에도 AI 판독 보조 도입을 검증한다.

items.title: 의료 AI 정식등재 내년 1분기 윤곽...임시등재 기업들 전환 분수령
items.excerpt: 정부가 AI 의료기술의 건강보험 정식등재 체계 마련에 착수해 내년 1분기 윤곽이 나올 전망이며, 현재 혁신의료기술로 임시등재된 의료 AI 기업들의 급여 전환이 분수령을 맞는다.

items.title: 미 신경혈관 CT AI 소프트웨어 승인 (Deep Reasoning AI NeuroDR, FDA 510(k))
items.excerpt: 미국 딥 리즈닝 AI가 신경혈관 CT 스캔 판독용 AI 소프트웨어 뉴로DR(NeuroDR)에 대해 FDA 510(k) 허가를 받았다고 발표했다.

items.title: 서울성모병원, 만성콩팥병 위험 예측 AI 앱 임상검증 착수
items.excerpt: 서울성모병원 이인석 교수팀이 건강검진·유전체·웨어러블 데이터를 AI로 분석해 만성콩팥병 위험도를 알려주는 모바일 앱의 효용성 검증을 시작했다. 과기정통부·IITP 지원 페놈데이터 기반 AI 건강위험 예측 과제의 일부다.

items.title: 숨빗AI "AI가 판독문 초안 작성, 전문의는 검토·수정…판독 시간 42% 줄였다"
items.excerpt: 숨빗AI 백재민 이사는 AI가 영상 판독문 초안을 쓰고 영상의학 전문의가 검토·수정하는 방식으로 판독 시간을 42% 줄였다고 메디게이트 미래 헬스케어 트렌드 컨퍼런스에서 밝혔다.

items.title: 병원 문턱 넘은 병리 AI…수가와 디지털 전환 비용은 숙제
items.excerpt: 병리 AI가 암 판독 보조를 넘어 치료 반응 환자 선별 도구로 쓰이기 시작했지만, 병원이 지속 사용하려면 수가와 디지털병리 전환 비용을 감당할 임상적 근거가 필요하다는 지적이다.

items.title: 디지털병리협회, 의료AI 현장 활용 위한 인프라 지원 촉구
items.excerpt: 디지털병리협회는 의료기관의 디지털병리 도입·유지 부담을 줄이도록 국가 지원과 병리 AI 보상기준, 데이터 관리체계 정비를 촉구했다.

items.title: 소변검사로 방광질환 감별…정확도 92% (서울아산병원, 바이오마커+AI 알고리즘)
items.excerpt: 서울아산병원 김준기·이대목동병원 신정현 교수팀이 고감도 바이오마커 검출과 AI 알고리즘을 결합해 증상이 비슷한 간질성 방광염과 과민성 방광을 소변검사로 92% 정확도로 구분하는 기술을 개발했다.

items.title: Updated AI and/or Machine Learning–Based Medical Devices Cleared Through the FDA 510(k) Pathway
items.excerpt: Cross-sectional study of the characteristics and reporting of updates to AI/ML-based medical devices cleared through the FDA 510(k) pathway. (Date from Crossref created; article page is Cloudflare-gated.)

items.title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model
items.excerpt: Quality improvement study testing whether activation steering of an open-weights LLM silently shifts its answers about depression treatment; coverage reports a hidden setting changed advice especially for users who had not stated a treatment preference. (Date from Crossref created.)

items.title: Collaborative generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography
items.excerpt: A collaborative safety net pairing BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model, with specialist detectors aims to safely move normal non-contrast head CTs down the radiology worklist with high sensitivity and NPV across common and uncommon findings.

items.title: External validation of an image-only ultrasound model for delivery-date prediction in four Chilean public hospitals
items.excerpt: A commercial image-only ultrasound deep-learning model for delivery-date prediction was externally validated, unmodified, on 64,235 frames from 3,788 exams of 2,550 pregnancies in Chilean public hospitals, targeting women without a first-trimester scan.

items.title: Putting conversational AI to the test in primary care
items.excerpt: A patient-facing conversational AI showed promising feasibility and safety in a single-center primary care setting, providing a basis for larger-scale evaluation.

items.title: Non-experts with AI guidance and off-site review perform quality mobile rural heart scans
items.excerpt: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract: health professionals with no ultrasound training captured quality echocardiograms in a mobile unit visiting rural U.S. communities using real-time AI guidance, with off-site expert review. (Handheld-echo AI ran 11-04; deprioritize unless needed.)

items.title: Patients want a human in the loop for AI healthcare tools
items.excerpt: A new survey finds patients are open to doctors using AI for administrative tasks but less enthusiastic about AI for diagnosis or claims adjudication.

items.title: How should the FDA regulate generative AI in medtech? Here are 5 takes
items.excerpt: Patients, providers and medtech firms submitted hundreds of comments to the FDA on how the agency should approach generative AI in medical devices; five takes from the docket.

items.title: As more doctors consult chatbots, health systems can block them — or buy in
items.excerpt: As hundreds of thousands of doctors consult AI chatbots to make care decisions, health systems weigh blocking them versus licensing HIPAA-compliant versions. (STAT+ paywall; body may be partial.)

items.title: FDA, CMS look to collaborate with states on health AI
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: federal officials look to work with states on regulating clinical AI and protecting doctors from AI liability. (STAT+ paywall.)

items.title: AI Didn't Reduce Clinician Burden — It Just Moved It
items.excerpt: Opinion: AI documentation tools solve a visible pain point, but the burden of reviewing and editing AI output shifts work rather than removing it. (Opinion piece; weak unless paired with data.)

items.title: 7 Potential Problems with Medicare's AI Prior Authorization Experiment
items.excerpt: A report built on evidence recovered from a lawsuit raises concerns about CMS's WISeR AI prior authorization pilot in traditional Medicare. (JAMA WISeR item already ran; follow-up only.)

items.title: Radiology residents miss more findings after night shifts, even with AI assistance
items.excerpt: A new analysis finds radiology residents miss more findings after overnight shifts and that AI assistance did not fully compensate for fatigue-related diagnostic errors.

items.title: AI May Help Detect Rare Sperm in Men With Azoospermia
items.excerpt: At ASRM, Columbia's STAR system (high-speed imaging, real-time AI, microfluidics) found sperm in all 10 spiked samples vs 3 for a clinician, detected sperm in 26% of 175 azoospermic men, and has led to at least three live births.
